data: NOAA geostationary weather pair — Americas continuous coverage
NOAA + NASA Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellite programme. Operational pair always positioned to cover Americas weather + hurricane tracking.

Geostationary Operational Environmental Satellite — NOAA's geostationary weather pair. GOES-19 (GOES-East at 75.2° W) and GOES-18 (GOES-West at 137.0° W) are the operational pair as of April 2025, providing continuous coverage of the Americas. GOES-16 is stored as backup; GOES-17 was decommissioned in January 2023. The GOES-R series carries the Advanced Baseline Imager capable of 30-second mesoscale scans for hurricane cores and severe-storm tracking. Built by Lockheed Martin; data products freely available.

50+ years of continuous Earth imaging — Landsat 1 to 9
Russia's GNSS — 24 sats, restored to full coverage in 2011
Russian 12-hour HEO comms — 63.4° critical inclination locks apogee over the north
GEO mobile comms — maritime, aviation, GMDSS backbone
